title: Corrupt Politics
paragraphs: Father was feeding the little rival together with the assistant.
“Muu!”
“Yes, yes, Sakura-chan, don’t be too clingy.”
Sakura-chan was getting jealous and clinging tightly. The assistant seemed to be opening up to Father more and more.
Was it thanks to the rival?
“What should we do next?”
“After checking around Eclair-san’s territory, we should head to Faubrey immediately using the portal.”
“Sounds good. Éclair, which areas do you plan to inspect?”

Currently, we were in the eastern village area. It seemed even the Three Heroes Church couldn’t track our return to Melromarc, as there were no assassins in sight so far. Well, in any case, we were just blending in, posing as regular adventurers.
“Hmm.”
Éclair spread out a map of Melromarc. It was the same area that Father had turned into his territory in the first world.
“I’d like to visit this general area. I want to see firsthand how much damage the villages and towns have suffered.”
“If I recall, Eclair-san’s parents passed away, leaving the territory unprotected and struggling, right?”
“Yes… According to Kitamura-dono, Iwatani-dono restored it in a different timeline. But I also need to conduct a preliminary investigation to report back to the Queen and Faubrey.”
“So, you’re gathering evidence…”
“Exactly. While I’m at it, I also plan to scout the hidden Three Heroes Church fortress that Kitamura-dono mentioned.”
Ren and Itsuki were studying the map seriously. I marked the location of the Three Heroes Church fortress on it.
“How about this? Ren-san and Yuki-san can check out the fortress and the nearby towns.”
“Got it. I picked up a stealth skill, so I should be able to manage. What about you, Itsuki?”
“I’ll check along the coastline of the territory with Kou-san. Motoyasu-san, could you go deep into the mountains and hunt other Dragon Emperors to collect fragments?”

“That sounds good. Gaelion-chan isn’t ready to fight yet… And as for me and Windia-chan… Well, Sakura-chan doesn’t seem interested in helping, and I doubt Motoyasu-kun wants to either, so I’m not sure what to do about level grinding.”
Father then turned to Éclair.
“What about you, Eclair-san? I think it’d be best if you accompanied someone.”
“In that case, I’d like to go with Iwatani-dono. There are areas within the territory that Amaki-dono and Kawasumi-dono won’t be covering, and I want to check those.”
“Understood. But try not to push yourself too hard. Windia-chan and Gaelion-chan still can’t fight yet.”
“…Gau?”
The rival assertively clung to Father, seeking attention. It was a little irritating. Meanwhile, the assistant wouldn’t let go of Father’s cape.
“I trust them to take care of things, but I suppose it’s natural to be concerned about Naofumi and the others.”
“We should set a schedule and take turns investigating. It’s not something we can finish in a single day.”
“…That’s true. But I have a feeling we’ll be witnessing the depths of human depravity… Itsuki, stay alert.”
“Yeah… Depending on the situation, it might be safer to move together rather than splitting up. Let’s regroup periodically.”

And so, we each went our separate ways to fulfill our assigned tasks. --- On the first day, I traveled around the major dragon habitats within Melromarc and obtained a Dragon Emperor fragment. The enemies weren’t particularly strong, so it was an easy victory. Next, I planned to search neighboring countries for areas with stronger dragons. With that in mind, my first day came to an end. Ren and Itsuki both had grim expressions.

“Just as Motoyasu said, there was a fortress. It was fairly large, yet difficult to find. From the outside, it’s hard to tell, but we confirmed people going in and out. The nearby town… is in a terrible state. It’s completely abandoned, either a ghost town or ruins.”
“It was the same on my end. I saw several corpses that had been left to rot, far beyond decomposition, already reduced to skeletons.”
They sighed repeatedly. Well, considering the nature of those responsible, it wasn’t surprising.
“But then, in the neighboring town, people were living as if nothing had happened… When I casually asked about the ruins next door, they just smiled and said, ‘It was divine punishment.’”

“Itsuki, don’t get too emotionally involved. That being said… seeing people crucified in the town square as a public spectacle—supposed criminals, apparently—it’s sickening. From what I saw, they were all demi-humans.”

Father silently continued preparing dinner. Considering he was the Shield Hero, regarded as a god by the demi-humans, it wasn’t surprising. Ren and Itsuki understood that rescuing demi-humans purely based on emotion wouldn’t be a good idea.
“I saw a similar sight in Siltvelt—humans being publicly executed as a warning.”
“If I hadn’t seen that, I might have rushed in recklessly. But in the end, I did nothing and just came back… What can I even do?”
Itsuki clenched his fists tightly, clearly frustrated.
“They probably truly believe the Waves were divine punishment. Corrupt politics, corrupt nobility… No matter the world, there will always be places rotten to the core.”
Father muttered quietly.
“It might actually be beneficial for them to experience some hardship firsthand. Maybe putting an end to the Waves too quickly isn’t necessarily the best approach?”
“That’s true… I can understand that perspective.”

“We might still be seeing only the worst aspects of things. I plan to visit more towns and investigate further. Itsuki, you must have also come across towns that value demi-humans, right? It’s important to confirm that not everyone is bad.”
“…Yes. There are certainly some terrible towns, but there are also ones that are still trying to protect demi-humans. Eclair-san, do you know of any others?”
“Hmm… The quick movements of the Heroes and the Filolials have been a great help. The remaining area is here.”
Éclair spread out a map. Ren, Itsuki, Father, and Éclair had marked the areas they had investigated with circles. It seemed they had covered a fair amount of ground.
“I’ve heard that slave hunting has been particularly active lately.”
“Yeah… The towns that shelter demi-humans are on high alert against slave hunters.”
“Originally, the country’s knights and soldiers were supposed to be deployed to hunt down national traitors, but…”
“If I remember correctly, according to Eclair-san, it’s the knights and soldiers themselves who are leading the slave hunts?”
“That’s right… At this point, people have no choice but to protect themselves.”
Éclair spoke with a frustrated tone.
“On our way to Faubrey, we heard about a slave-hunting organization. I thought about whether we could destroy it, but… we should resume our journey to Faubrey as soon as possible.”
“Yeah, that’s a good idea. Once Gaelion and Windia are a little stronger, we’ll head out as soon as we can.”
Father then began feeding the Dragon Emperor’s core stone, which I had brought as a gift, to my rival.
“Here you go, Gaelion. Say ‘ahh’.”
“Gaaw♪”
My rival happily accepted the core stone from Father and munched on it.
“Grow up strong and big, Gaelion.”
“Gaw♪”

The assistant, also in high spirits, picked up my rival and swung their arms playfully. It’s fine that they get along well, but they should consider Sakura-chan’s feelings. Monopolizing Father isn’t acceptable.
“Here you go, Sakura-chan.”
“Yay! I won’t lose to Gaelion!”
Father, though slightly exasperated, fed Sakura-chan as well.
“Will Gaelion grow quickly…? Probably not as fast as a Filolial, but…”
“Really?”
Right now, my rival was about the same size as the assistant. Still, they were smaller than when we first met.
“Well, leveling up alone is a bit… Sakura-chan isn’t really motivated, and she’s gone off to help Motoyasu-kun, so if I’m just walking around with Eclair-san, things are slow.”
“Leveling up, huh…?”
At that moment, Ren and Itsuki approached. The assistant quickly hid behind Father’s back.
“Why don’t we do some night training? Heroes don’t gain experience from each other, but Windia-san and Gaelion should be able to.”
“If we have the energy, that might be a good idea… Are you sure?”
“I heard that monsters that spilled over from the last Wave are still roaming this area. It wouldn’t hurt to hunt them down for the sake of maintaining security.”
